text: = Set operations union, intersect, and except « Each of the above operations automatically eliminates duplicates = To retain all duplicates use the corresponding multiset versions union all, intersect all and except all. = Suppose a tuple occurs m times in r and n times in s, then, it occurs: « m +ntimes in r union all s « min(m,n) times in r intersect all s « max(0, m - n) times in r except all s
